The structure of Ca8Mg2O10 (reduced formula Ca4MgO5) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imma (No. 38), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Ca centers with eight O neighbors (2.56–2.76 Å) and Mg centers with four O neighbors (1.95–1.96 Å), while O centers show three geometric neighbors (one Ca and two Mg). The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 20 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis indicates corner- and edge-sharing between 8-vertex Ca coordination polyhedra.
